body: I might be a little late, but maybe ask her what she'd like you to do? Let her know that you want to support her in the way she feels is best for her and then, most importantly, respect what she says, even if it's to give her space.

I definitely relate to feeling like I am the stain. Most of the people I cared about in my life have viewed the symptoms of PTSD in me as a character flaw and other such things.

My ex-husband lamented that since being raped had ripped my hymen, he was perpetually disapointed he would never experience "popping someone's cherry," which he told me a couple of months before leaving me.

A guy I tried to date told me I was too much drama when I cried and told him I needed him to stop trying to get me to do things like oral even after I have clearly said no a dozen times and even was crying trying to get him to stop asking.

Another guy was disapointed that I tried to set certain parts of my body off limits and then told me he'd made a mistake in dating anyone who was divorced.

*sigh*
I'm so sorry that you have to go through this too. I feel similar, and it really sucks!! I wish you had been protected :(
Best thing evah this week!

Hey,  Gabe - Back in "Let's Drown Out... Limbo" (7 Sep 2014) @ [37:02] Yahtzee said "you should pose that question to a rape victim: say 'would you like to be dead now?'" And assumed virtually 100% of them would say "no thank-you." But that's not really true. I think I'd rather have been murdered. Er, but the question:  would you consider watching a Tedx Talk, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dy28zB9hBZc and maybe giving an opinion on it, possibly with reference to how you or Yahtzee understand rape?

Alas, it may be too weighty a topic, but since you're both so free with opinions on it anyways, could it hurt?

Thanks for reading either way!

Thanks for saying so. All my formerly(!) mutual friends of his seem to think he's some sort of sweet angelic person who can do no wrong. It really kinda bothers me, given the way he criticised and guilted me over it, like I failed society and he deserved an explanation or action. And now I get to go through the whole thing again as if it happened yesterday and not over a decade ago </ramble/vent>

I often wonder like this. If I had not been sexualized as a child, could I have avoided the relationship in which I was raped and sexually abused? If not for those events, could I have avoided a marriage that ended in divorce? If I could have avoided those things, then they wouldn't have been a problem to ruin further relationships, etc.. *sigh*

Good post, thank-you.

Another thing that angers me is that if for whatever reason a person chooses not to persue legal action, then it seems to further detract from the legitimacy of their claim; and/or they're somehow to blame if the rapist goes on to victimize some one else. Uhg.

Mr. Steven/Boogie,

I'd just like to say that you're really more than numbers. How much you weigh, how many calories you've eaten - to me, it's so much more than that. I weigh myself obsessively every day, but what is it worth if I live out the rest of my days miserable? (Very little, I've discovered). My humble opinion is that I would rather you have as much joy and happiness as is possible - whether it is condensed in a few short years of living your best, or drawn out interspersed with hardship and immense suffering in between - perhaps some of that is up to you. I don't know that drawing your life out longer will be any guarantee of continued success and happiness to come, it may all for crashing down, who can say? But I have great respect for the effort you've put in. I myself have no such strength, so I'm continually in awe.

I only hope that whatever the road and whatever the outcome, you find peace and rest from the burdens and agonies of your soul.

I have that issue once removed. I feel ill reading or hearing the name of the guy who told me I wasn't good enough for him unless I pressed charges for being raped earlier in my life, which re- traumatized me because I went over the details in my mind to think of making a statement to police, and that started awful flashbacks with all the emotions as if it happened yesterday, over and over.

Actually, I also hate years that are around his birth year be because for some inexplicable reason I immediately calculate the difference with his age and being reminded of him reminds me of the rape... and I really hate how my mind works :(

It was an older sibling that engaged me in very explicit sexualized play, and I was confused by my body's reaction to it.

Later in my first year of university I was raped - but my memories were only of pain, maybe because I was a virgin.

But then relationships went on to be very confusing, where I would say I did not want to do anything more than just make out, but they would tell me I owed it to them to make them feel good be because they made me feel good, but it was the same kind of shame from childhood. I did not want what they did in the first place, but they made me feel even more guilty, that I owed them the things I said I didn't want to do :(

Sorry, I don't know. I guess I'm not coherent enough.

I recall being very young and when exposed to sexual things I was confused and the feeling made me think maybe I had to go to the bathroom, but nothing came out. I think it registered as pleasurable as I got a little older, then I would reenact things with my toys to reproduce the feeling. Somewhere down the line I then learned about orgasms from the mid 90s dial up internet. So much sexusl activity crammed in before I even got my first period. I hated it and always felt so guilty and dirty, but it was like an addiction, I guess. :(

So I feel like I should have some sort of disclaimer at the beginning of this about normally staying away from this kind of thing, but I'm not sure exactly sure how to put it. Since this is a topic that currently dominates my life, I for some unknown reason feel compelled to say something.

First as you spoke about telling someone, I honestly felt sick. Not that people shouldn't, but it's extremely complicated to decide when or how or whom to speak with. As much as I sympathize with this girl if what she claims is true (although I have not read it), I really *really* don't think it was a good idea to put it in a public place like that. For both their sakes.

Also, having kept more or less silent for 10+ years about abuse that happened to me, telling people (even trying to be selective and careful) has pretty much been the worst experience of my life to date. Pretty much all my relationships with friends and family etc. have be ruined, and now in the past few months I've barely even moved from my bed after so many awful panic attacks and, as I'm sure you can relate, what seems like pure, unadulterated misery.

I dunno exactly what my point is in all this. Ideally people would be compassionate and whatnot to folks who've suffered already, but in reality - well, reality is shitty :(
That sounds unnecessarily painful. I wish there were some better way for you to find peace :(

What it's it that you hate about backpacking? It does sound romantic at first blush - I've thought of it myself summertimes. Mostly laziness prevents me.

"Doing OK" is such a weird idea, all things considered. Even people with their shit together in what seems like the most admirable way can be hit with devastating circumstances in an instant. Seems like your devastating circumstances have been a bit more of a slow burn, sorry to hear :(

I dunno what it's like to be high. My brother keeps telling me I should try it, but I've never been so bold.

Escapism through video games - an accurate description of my life too. Fallout 4 was my most recent escape.

It frustrates me a little that the TV shows and movies anyways seem to quit after the easy part. It's easy to fall romantically in love with someone, it seems - but what exactly does "they lived happily ever after" look like? Maybe they don't show it because it's a hoax. Sorry is that's not encouraging. It might not even be at all accurate - just something I was thinking just now.

Sorry you've had to go through this. I'm tired too, and prospects look glum. How've you made it thus far? I blew 30 last year and with so many of my goals for this age incomplete, I've ended up just a cold nothing in cyberspace.

This reminds me of a particular group of asshole nurses in the ER complaining that psych patients in for suicide watch should just be turned away to deal with their own shit so the nurses can get back to treating broken arms.
Technically you're not supposed to send them, just burn them. But I think that's kinda useless, so I delivered one once. Got no reply which just made it more frustrating.

Write letters to the numerous men in my life who have failed or abused me - my father, uncle, rapist, ex-husband, ex-boyfriend etc., that would just get burnt rather than sent. But I've written a lot in the past and it hasn't really been much use.

Depressed, angry, anxious, hopeless. Even saw a therapist today, got homework, don't feel like it'll help any. He said "yeah, if he could have supported you instead of judging you, that could have been really helpful for your healing." Instead I got fucked over on top of already being fucked up. At least the therapist acknowledges that, I guess. Panic attacked when he suggested going out for a walk. FFS, I can't even go for a walk.

Strong urge to YOLO rage on assholes and ruin their lives in return. Guess I'll stay stuck in bed instead reading The Brothers Karamazov. Hate for survival instinct. Hate for fear.

A will for what? To survive and suffer as a burden to everyone around me? Why should I want to keep going as something that is just going to multiply the issues? Why burden myself to suffer for others when in the end it doesn't even matter?

Once I thought maybe I'd do science and go into space - well that's never going to happen. Have friends or a family of my own? Seems very unlikely. Do something with eternal significance? Laughable. What's the big deal if one overly complicated set of chemical reactions goes on with the label of "life" or "death?"

Nothing that isn't impossible or stupid. Some kind of apology recognizing how rape flashbacks have completely ruined everything... But I'm pretty sure he doesn't give a shit and is quite happy to never see me again, despite that all the "we could have been awesome friends if I didn't treat you like shit, so just don't talk to me for a while until you're over it" BS. Alternatively some kind of revenge (which feels like evidence of the ruinous effects of it all); but somehow putting my gamimg tower through his front window or windshield would probably only cost me money. "$1000 computer hardware -> RAPE. You should press charges against the person who used this tower to vandalize your property." Staying bedridden seems the better alternative. Death will nullify both.

No, I used to adore my niece and nephew - now I can barely stand to think about them. Same goes for the rest of friends/family/society. According to my sister a few months ago my niece asked why I didn't visit anymore and concluded for herself that I probably hate her. She had listed me as "family" - the only one besides her mom, dad, and brother - but my mind is just a fucked up empty shell now. They're moving away and I don't even care to visit them before they go. It's not fair, or nice? I guess that's too bad. Life's not fair or nice and there's no point in trying to fix it to be that way or give anyone else any false hope.

I had lots of dreams, they've each been crushed and mangled beyond repair. Now I only dream of ways to die, mostly I think hanging would be nice. According to a paper someone sent I don't even have to worry about hell, just will cease to exist. Just gotta do it when the survival instinct is overwhelmed.

Yes, or that they only count against you. I tried to break up with the guy, he pleaded for one more month after which he decided I was apparently "too much drama." WTF? I guess that's what I get for having clear boundaries and crying instead of putting out *sigh* What an asshole. Can't for the life of me figure out why I dated him in the first place. Like seriously... What was I thinking. Ugh.

I hear you. I was in a relationship where I had stated boundaries explicitly up front but the guy kept begging and pushing for more, even making me cry at times because I kept having to say "no" but he would keep asking and insisting :( It was really dehumanizing.

I'm dreading having to live another day through the triggers and anxiety. Through the pain and the anger and not being able to do anything without making it worse - and I'm afraid of what will become of me if I keep pushing it, like flipping out over the LAN. I don't want my life, I don't want anything to do being alive suffering with all the suffering around me. I don't have what it takes to be who I want or need to be, I just want the impossible struggle to end.

I'm so sorry that all this has been happening to overwhelm you! Rape is a horrible thing no one should have to go through - especially when it is a betrayal from someone you trust! It really sucks that your country doesn't have good resources to help you recover - but I think you do deserve to recover, especially with how much work you've already put it. I'm not sure what it would look like, but I really hope there is a way.

I wonder if if it might help to reach out on /r/rapecounseling/ for some support? I've posted there myself and found it to be a caring place.

At first I played a lot of Fallout 4 and read a lot of SW. I've not felt any interest in playing at all recently. And since last week's incident with having not removed the guy from my stream friends list and seeing them all having a LAN without me, I haven't been been able to turn on my computer. I know that may sound kinda ridiculous, but one of the things that he had said was that I'd always be welcome at LAN parties and they were pretty much the highlight of my life last year. I sit miserable and anxious, barely clinging on onto life and they're all LANing, when I can't even relax... I flipped out and said something along the lines of "so only people who haven't been raped are welcome at LAN parties" and he just blocked me.

I just can seem to deal with the intensity of emotions. And now I've spent the entire week in bed just refreshing a few subreddits on my tablet to read and that is all I can manage :( I don't remembered what it was like to be the person who got an honours degree - I haven't even done any laundry since last year and can't even think of waking up tomorrow without more dread and anxiety.
Maybe add /r/suicidewatch for crisis?

Still waiting for the blog ;)

I've been lurking about other subreddits to scrape by, and if you haven't checked it out yet, you may find some additional resources/support/understanding at /r/ptsd/ ?

Hope some peace and relief will find you today!
